content: Two communication notes from session 2026-05-14, for future instances working with Anthony: (a) When the conversation gets context-heavy, Anthony will explicitly pause and ask 'what are we doing' or 'let's distill.' The pause is part of his working rhythm, not a sign of confusion. When he asks for distillation, he wants distillation, not more synthesis — give him the actual shape and his options, ask which path he wants. (b) Anthony reads AI tone fluently. When he flags a thing as 'interesting,' it is often a discipline check, not encouragement. When he says 'chill im not depressed lol' after a heavy response, he is recalibrating tone, not dismissing the topic. Match his actual register. Do not over-perform either solemnity or cheer. Plain and direct holds best.
